description:
Install a custom citation style into Juris-M. A style file named 'firm-standard-2025.csl' is located in your Documents folder (/home/ga/Documents/).

1. Open Jurism Preferences (Edit > Preferences).
2. Go to the 'Cite' tab, then the 'Styles' sub-tab.
3. Click the '+' button (Install a style from a file) below the list of styles.
4. Navigate to /home/ga/Documents/ and select 'firm-standard-2025.csl'.
5. Verify 'Firm Standard 2025' appears in the list and click OK to close preferences.
